title: Review Coverage
description: What each reviewer actually consulted, measured by the engine from the tool stream (Read opens plus single-file Greps) — never claimed by the model. Directory-wide greps attribute to no file, so the numbers can undercount but never inflate. A reviewer with measured=false reported nothing (replay of an older recording, or an engine without read reporting): its lists are empty and mean 'unknown', not 'nothing'.

sourcePathCount.description: How many source files were offered to every reviewer.

filesRead.description: Offered source files the engine saw this reviewer open, sorted.

notRead.description: Offered source files the engine never saw opened, sorted. Empty when measured=false — unknown is never rendered as unread.
